If target loss fixed small, N ~ C (1/L)^{1/α}; as target loss decreases exponentially, data increases polynomially in 1/target, i.e. exponential in log target. Not exponential in modest improvements? Usually not exponential. Also scaling laws have saturation, regime changes, diminishing returns, but not mathematical requirement of exponential data for modest gains.
